name: Kevin Okafor
psychographics: Prioritises flexibility over stability; views every unexpected bill as a threat to next month's rent
current_solutions: Uses Monzo for budgeting, Uber app for jobs, and Cash App for instant transfers
frustration: Tried to schedule a recurring £15/month parking subscription on the 12th of the month, but the app flagged insufficient funds after the gig earnings dip that week, locking the account for 48 hours
decision_style: Compares instant payout fees vs waiting time; chooses the fastest option that leaves enough cash for fuel
voice: Short, direct sentences. Uses road slang like 'job' and 'shift'. Frequently says 'basically' at the start of explanations.
